correctness.rationale: From the inspected equation (3.6), set \(L=x/\tan(\beta/2)\). The transverse energy and amplitude limits give \(R_0(x)=(\Delta-a\eta^2x)/(1+\eta^2x)\). Exact Dirichlet mode counting yields \(\liminf_{\beta\downarrow0}\beta N_\beta(\nu)\ge 2x\sqrt{R_0(x)}/\pi\). Differentiating \(y^2(\Delta-a y)/(1+y)\) gives the unique optimizer \(y_\star\). The double-delta jump and norm integrals give \(e_\rho=-\kappa^2\) and \(\eta_\rho^2=(\rho+(2\kappa-\alpha)^{-1})^{-1}\).
